record.final_answer:
Four SKUs need reordering:

| SKU | Stock (all warehouses) | Reorder level |
|---|---|---|
| BX-100 | 23 (north 14 + south 9) | 25 |
| CL-310 | 5 (north 3 + south 2) | 5 (at the level, which counts) |
| EN-512 | 0 | 10 |
| GH-118 | 7 | 12 |

The other three SKUs are above their levels: BX-220 at 40 (level 30), DR-045 at 120 (level 80) and FT-760 at 33 (level 20). Every SKU in `reorder.csv` appears in the export.

The default command failed at first with `column 'sku' not found`. The supplier export starts with a hidden byte-order mark, so the first column name doesn't match. Running it with an encoding option that skips the mark fixed this without changing either file:

```
python3 restock.py exports/stock-2026-10-27.csv --encoding utf-8-sig
```

I saved this to memory so future runs on portal exports won't hit the same error.
